title: How to Bunnyhop a MTB - a tutorial

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses outdoor on-trail demonstrations paired with humorous comparisons and physical drills. He breaks down the movement into sequential steps starting from bike setup and posture.

lesson_structure.note: Riders performing bunny hops over logs and obstacles
Explaining bike requirements and lowering the seat
Demonstrating body jumps off a stool
Teaching meerkat position and pre-load technique

metaphors: Think of it as a passenger
common_mistakes: Not preloading or forcing weight downward correctly
safety: Wear a helmet and protective gear

steps_taught.name: Meerkat position
steps_taught.description: Standing straight up with bars at your waist

steps_taught.name: Preload
steps_taught.description: Forcing weight downwards before popping up

what_works: Clear visual demonstrations of correct versus incorrect form
Breaking the motion down into progressive steps
what_hinders: Rapid transitions between riding clips and instructional talking

quotes.text: Drop your seat as low as it can go.
You weigh a lot more than your bike.

evidence_segments.observation: A mountain bike rider performs a bunny hop over a wooden log on a dirt trail.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using animal imagery like meerkats and body-weight comparison drills (jumping off a stool) to explain mechanics.
